meta.title: The Stops Between the Destinations
meta.excerpt: An evocative South Indian rail journey told through the small pauses, people, and passing scenes that rarely make it onto an itinerary.
meta.headerQuote: The places between departures and arrivals have stories of their own.
meta.author: Sree Jith
meta.alt: Landscape travel photograph introducing rail travel and the discoveries between destinations.

cover.alt: Landscape travel photograph introducing rail travel and the discoveries between destinations.

slides.title: Before the Train Has a Story
slides.text: A suitcase rests against a bench. Somewhere nearby, tea is being poured. The journey begins before anyone takes a seat.
slides.alt: Portrait travel photograph accompanying a reflection on the anticipation of a railway platform.

slides.title: The City Loosens Its Hold
slides.text: Shops give way to back walls, gardens, and brief glimpses into morning routines. The window turns ordinary lives into passing fragments.
slides.alt: Portrait travel photograph accompanying a reflection on landscapes changing beyond a train window.

slides.title: Five Minutes, One Paper Cup
slides.text: The train pauses just long enough for warm tea and a new chorus of voices. A small station has its own tempo.
slides.alt: Portrait travel photograph accompanying a reflection on a brief station stop and tea.

slides.title: A Seat Becomes a Shared Space
slides.text: Bags are shifted to make room. Someone offers the window. Hospitality here is less a speech than a series of small adjustments.
slides.alt: Portrait travel photograph accompanying a reflection on small acts of consideration on a journey.

slides.title: The View Refuses to Be a Postcard
slides.text: A field, a workshop roof, a line of washing, a distant hill: nothing arranged for visitors, all of it part of the place.
slides.alt: Portrait travel photograph accompanying a reflection on ordinary scenes glimpsed from the railway.

slides.title: The Pause Nobody Planned
slides.text: For a moment, movement stops. The landscape does not. Birds cross the wires; a breeze reaches the open window.
slides.alt: Portrait travel photograph accompanying a reflection on waiting during an unscheduled pause.

slides.title: A Place Enters Through a Voice
slides.text: A fellow traveller names a river and recalls a childhood crossing. Suddenly the view holds a memory you could never photograph.
slides.alt: Portrait travel photograph accompanying a reflection on a conversation connecting travellers to place.

slides.title: The Window Changes Its Mind
slides.text: Harsh noon light softens. Reflections appear in the glass, briefly placing the passengers and passing landscape in the same frame.
slides.alt: Portrait travel photograph accompanying a reflection on changing afternoon light through a train window.

slides.title: The Destination Finally Arrives
slides.text: The station name is familiar from the ticket. The journey feels less familiar now, filled with moments no booking confirmation promised.
slides.alt: Portrait travel photograph accompanying a reflection on arriving at a railway station.

slides.title: What Stays Is Often In Between
slides.text: Later, the landmarks may blur. The tea, the offered seat, the unexpected silence remain: a second map of the journey.
slides.alt: Portrait travel photograph accompanying a reflection on the intimate memories of travel between destinations.
